headline: AFF AI CLUB storms into ARC-3 gold as two teams slip out

sections.text: AFF AI CLUB surged from 30th to 9th at 38.98, up 5.06, to claim a gold place. The move carried two teams the other way: AI_hwlee fell from 17th to 19th at 36.54, while YUTO KOJIMA dropped from 18th to 21st at 36.14; both scores were unchanged.

The public gold line now runs through 18th, so this reshuffle puts AFF AI CLUB comfortably inside the medal band while AI_hwlee and YUTO KOJIMA sit outside it. These are provisional public standings; the medals will be decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
